items.title: Submit repair cost estimate and damage photos
items.quote: Schicken Sie uns den Kostenvoranschlag und Fotos der Schäden bitte innerhalb von 12 Werktagen nach dem Datum dieses Schreibens (Werktage sind Montag bis Samstag; Sonntage und gesetzliche Feiertage zählen nicht mit).
items.computation: Letter is dated Monday 29.09.2025. The period is expressed as 12 'Werktage' (defined by the letter itself as Monday-Saturday, excluding Sundays and statutory public holidays), running 'nach dem Datum dieses Schreibens' (after the date of this letter), so counting starts on the day after the letter's date, i.e. 30.09.2025 (§187 Abs.1 BGB analogy). Counting working days per the letter's own definition (Mon-Sat count, Sun/holidays skipped), and noting that 03.10.2025 (Tag der Deutschen Einheit, Friday) is a nationwide public holiday and therefore skipped: 30.09 Tue=1, 01.10 Wed=2, 02.10 Thu=3, 03.10 Fri=holiday-skip, 04.10 Sat=4, 05.10 Sun=skip, 06.10 Mon=5, 07.10 Tue=6, 08.10 Wed=7, 09.10 Thu=8, 10.10 Fri=9, 11.10 Sat=10, 12.10 Sun=skip, 13.10 Mon=11, 14.10 Tue=12. The 12th qualifying working day is Tuesday 14.10.2025, which is itself a working day under the letter's definition, so no further weekend/holiday shift is needed.
